## Reconciled behavior

`GameView.notify(message,error?,options?:NoticeOptions)` is compatible; `presentationStep(state)` runs once after each completed fixed simulation step and event delivery. Actual finite, source-tagged emitted calls alone reach `threatCall(origin,state)`. App owns the measured-ascent accumulator and forwards `blockedAscent(visible)`; no extra movement query or saved history is introduced.

The pure notice state has no queue. Priority is persistence failure/reminder, current hazard, action/system error, action success; successful system/save bookkeeping uses a separate chip. Panel actions remain singular inline results and clear on switch/close/replacement. Trial lifetimes are action 4 active seconds, hazard 6 active, release 2.5 active, call 3 active, errors/persistence 12 wall seconds and chip 3 wall seconds. Pause freezes active clocks; one wall timer handles the next expiry and is reset/disposed. These are implementation trials, not validated human timings.

Actual disengagement clears stale warning/call and can briefly show “Calls fading.” The call cue retains a copied emission point and uses current listener pose/yaw/pitch; it does not track the live animal, promise visibility, or show a through-wall silhouette. `airSupply` supplies actual craft/refuge/surface/emergency/suit semantics. Ascent requires 0.45 seconds of requested rise, actual rise at most 10% of request and solid limitation over 50%, epsilon 1e-5, with surface limitation excluded and explicit progress/release/actor/pause/replacement/graphics resets. Compact pulse cost is danger/distraction-only; full information remains in Hold.
